title: ExportLanguageResourcesOnly with `*` on a server that has `en` only
exercises: LP-111, LP-112: `*` becomes the server's codes, `en` is removed, so the list is empty and the engine sends no translated-value request; the reshaping steps of LP-140 to LP-145 still run on the plain answer.
note: Recorded while dev had the Language `en` only. With a second Language the `*` expands to its code and the same item is exported with translations: see the `lang-*` cases (seeded and cleaned up by `oracle:export-scratch-cases`).
